models.title: AI models
models.empty: No downloadable models are available in this build.
models.consentBody: This model runs fully on your device. It is {{size}} and is downloaded once from Hugging Face; after that it works offline.
models.consentLicense: By downloading you accept the model license: {{license}}.

error.DISK_SPACE: Not enough free disk space for this model.
error.NETWORK: The download failed. Check your connection and try again; it will resume where it stopped.
error.CHECKSUM: The downloaded file is corrupted. Try downloading again.

dl.title: Download the AI models
dl.body: To analyze your speech, Engclaw needs these models. They run fully on your device and are downloaded once from Hugging Face; after that everything works offline. By downloading you accept each model's license.
dl.allReady: All models are installed. You can close this and try again.
dl.paused: Paused — resume to continue where it stopped.
dl.location: Models are saved in this folder:
dl.folderNotWritable: Engclaw cannot write to {{dir}}. Choose another folder.
dl.folderNoSpace: This folder has {{free}} free but {{needed}} (plus some headroom) is needed. Choose another folder.
dl.notMoved: Models already downloaded stay in the previous folder; they are not moved. Download them again here, or copy the folders over yourself.

denied.title: Microphone access was denied.
denied.macos: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and enable Engclaw, then restart the app.
denied.windows: Open Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone and allow desktop apps to use the microphone.
denied.generic: Allow microphone access for Engclaw in your system settings, then try again.

mic.notfound: No microphone was found. Connect one and try again.
mic.unknown: Could not start recording. Close other apps that use the microphone and try again.

audio.decodeError: This file could not be read as audio.
audio.truncated: Clip trimmed to the first {{seconds}} seconds.

feedback.NEEDS_WORK: You need to better pronounce these words: {{words}}

loading.stage2: Still working — the first run loads the models…
loading.stage3: Almost there, this is taking longer than usual…

reference.modelMissing: Download the reference voice model in AI models first.
reference.failed: Could not play the reference. Try again.

practice.placeholder: Type or paste the sentence you want to say…

error.modelMissing: The pronunciation models are not downloaded yet. Download them in AI models, then try again.

history.fileError: That file could not be used: {{message}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tune how Engclaw looks, listens and stores your data.
settings.modelsHint: Speech models run on this device, so your audio never leaves your computer.
settings.themeHint: Pick a look, or follow your system.
settings.silenceAutoStopHint: Ends a take when you stop speaking.
settings.checkForUpdatesHint: Looks for a newer version when the app starts.
settings.dataHint: Practice history, recordings and preferences are stored only on this computer.
settings.deleteBody: This permanently removes your practice history, recordings and preferences. Downloaded models are kept.

captions.hidden: Captions are hidden. The agent is still speaking.

shell.comingSoonBody: This part of Engclaw is not available yet.

home.welcomeBody: Practice speaking English with feedback that stays on your device. Pick where to start.

practice.title: Practice pronunciation
practice.body: Read a sentence or speak freely and see which sounds to fix.

shadowing.title: Shadow a video
shadowing.body: Repeat YouTube sentences with a transcript, or test yourself with dictation.

game.title: Pronunciation game
game.body: Pass chapters one word at a time and collect stars.

home.modelsNotice: Speech models are not downloaded yet. They are needed the first time you record.
home.noRecent: Your recent attempts will appear here.
home.backBody: Pick up where you left off, or start something new.
home.noProviderBody: Connect ChatGPT or an OpenAI-compatible API to talk with the agent.
home.modelReady: Speech models are ready on this device.
home.offlineBody: Practice and the game keep working. YouTube videos, word images and the AI agent need a connection.

models.intro: Pronunciation needs about {{size}} of models, stored on this device. Your audio never leaves your computer.
models.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet and retry; the download resumes where it stopped.

helper.free: Say anything you like. We transcribe it, you fix the text, then we check your pronunciation.
helper.read: Type or paste a text, then read it aloud.

practice.reviewHint: Fix any mistakes in the text, then press “Check my pronunciation”.
practice.reviewHintRead: Happy with your recording? Press “Check my pronunciation”.
practice.emptyResult: Record something to see your score
practice.emptyDetail: Phonemes, pitch and words appear here after you record.
practice.tip: Tip: for “th”, put your tongue between your teeth and blow air gently.
practice.pitchSummary: Pitch contour: your voice follows the reference closely, with a lower rise on the last word.
practice.keptAudio: Your recording and text are kept, so you do not need to record again.
practice.historyEmpty: No attempts yet. Your last 5 attempts appear here.
practice.savedNote: Saved to History with its recording.
practice.switchBody: A recording is in progress. Switching stops it and discards the audio. Your text and results are kept.
practice.pitchEmptyBody: The recording is too short or too quiet to track your pitch. Record a longer sentence to see the contour.
practice.pitchLowBody: Background noise made the pitch unreliable. Treat this chart as a rough guide and try again somewhere quieter.
practice.pickWord: Select a word that needs work to see its sounds.

shadowing.heading: Practice with any YouTube video

error.invalid: That doesn't look like a YouTube link.
error.noTranscript: This video has no transcript, so it can't be used for shadowing. Please try another video — pick one that shows captions (CC) on YouTube.
error.unavailable: This video can't be played here. Please try another video.
error.network: Couldn't reach YouTube. Check your connection and try again.

shadowing.noRecents: Videos you practise with will appear here.
shadowing.sentenceHidden: Sentence hidden. Hover or press H to reveal.
shadowing.sampleLine: Sample sentence number {{n}} of the video.
shadowing.autoContinueHint: After the last play, wait this percentage of the sentence length for your turn, then move to the next sentence. Turn the switch off to disable it.

provider.title: Set up your AI partner
provider.intro: Converse sends your words and a short analysis to the provider you choose. Audio never leaves your device.
provider.chatgptHint: Uses your ChatGPT account. No API key needed.
provider.signingInHint: Finish signing in in your browser, then come back here.
provider.expiredBody: Your session expired. Sign in again to keep talking.
provider.errorBody: Sign-in did not finish. Check your connection and try again.

settings.sent: Your transcribed words and a short pronunciation summary are sent to the provider.

converse.emptyList: Say hello to start your first conversation
converse.emptyCards: No cards yet — they appear as you talk. Switch to the transcript to read along.
converse.interrupted: Interrupted — the rest of the reply was not spoken.
converse.correctionWhy: Use the past tense for something that already happened.
converse.marketMeaning: A place where people buy and sell goods.
converse.marketExample: I buy fresh fruit at the market.
converse.tipBody: Add -ed to regular verbs; learn the irregular ones, such as go → went.
converse.cardError: This card couldn't be shown. Here is the text instead.
converse.idle: Press Space or the mic to start
converse.captionsOff: Captions are hidden. Audio is unchanged.
converse.micDisabled: Microphone off until a provider is set up
converse.signedInToast: Signed in to {{provider}}. You can start talking.

dictionary.def1: Look at something closely to check it.
dictionary.def2: Officially examine a person or place.
dictionary.example: She inspected the engine before the trip.

prompt.differ: How is it different from “look at”?

dictionary.recentHint: Type to search, or pick a recent word.
dictionary.pickWord: Pick a word to see its page.
dictionary.tryAnother: Try another spelling, or search by a root such as “spect”.
dictionary.liveHint: Click a word to open the dictionary. Press Esc to close; focus returns to the word.

game.coach: Say each word correctly 5 times to pass a chapter.
game.leaveBody: Your progress this run ({{n}}/5) will be lost.
game.offlineAudio: Audio is unavailable offline. Download the voice model or reconnect to hear examples.
game.analysisFailed: Couldn't analyse that attempt — try again. It was not counted.
game.micExclusive: Recording is off while you talk to the agent.
game.askReply: “{{target}}” — here is what it means and how to use it.
game.askHint: Ask about the whole target. Your run is not affected.
game.noProviderHint: Set up an AI provider in Settings to ask the agent.
